combined_v5_rule.name: clause_local_region_graph_v5

ordered_stages.name: protect_and_segment
ordered_stages.rule: Build clause-local top-level regions while protecting parenthetical and lexical spans; retain exact source offsets.

ordered_stages.name: resolve_wrapper_boundaries
ordered_stages.rule: Discover prefix, suffix, and open-list wrapper marker/content spans before constructing coordination members. Wrapper markers are graph metadata and exclusion boundaries, not projected items.

ordered_stages.name: form_attachment_regions
ordered_stages.rule: Identify parent-first regions introduced by explicit cues or protected parentheses and postposed 等+head regions. Keep direct open enumerations distinct from illustrative examples.

ordered_stages.name: reject_preference_only_postposed_parent
ordered_stages.rule: For a postposed attachment candidate created from 等, reject only that candidate when its complete right tail, after closing punctuation, is solely a priority/preference wrapper. Do not suppress an independent explicit 如 or parenthetical parent-first attachment, and do not turn a direct open surface list into examples.

ordered_stages.name: exclude_local_prepositional_wrapper
ordered_stages.rule: Inside an attachment-bearing region only, remove the already resolved leading prepositional wrapper marker from the example body before splitting members. Never strip 对 globally or from a lexical member.

ordered_stages.name: classify_connectors_by_innermost_region
ordered_stages.rule: Assign connector roles from the innermost protected region before splitting: quantifier, example, embedded, then surface. A character is one connector label at one exact span; lexical punctuation remains protected rather than promoted.

ordered_stages.name: construct_members_and_explicit_scopes
ordered_stages.rule: Split members using only connectors licensed for that region. Preserve nested outer-example and inner-embedded groups. Apply a shared scope only when an explicit source prefix, suffix, head, predicate, domain, result, or evidence span governs at least two annotated members.
ordered_stages.e4_exclusion: Do not add the rejected E4 candidate-versus-application compatibility heuristic.

ordered_stages.name: project_from_graph
ordered_stages.rule: Project ordered source-anchored surface items and examples from the graph. Exclude wrappers and embedded-only members; do not canonicalize, paraphrase, or use fixture labels at runtime.

global_invariants: All spans are half-open exact slices of source_text.
Every shared-scope target is an annotated coordination member.
Every attachment has a non-priority source parent and at least one example.
Every projected value occurs exactly in source_text.
No stage reads fixture id, job id, employer, title, gold, or expected output.
No category-specific dispatch is introduced to activate the combined stages.

evaluation_protocol.development_gate_timing: Freeze the v5 source hash, then execute one full 20-fixture evaluation and one regression evaluation. Record raw output before computing the decision.
evaluation_protocol.failure_policy: If any criterion fails, keep v4 as the frozen reference, reveal the failed v5 output for diagnosis, and create a new preregistration version before another combined-rule attempt.

G2-E2-wrapper-boundary.improvement_definition: A fixture's combined missing+unexpected count across wrapper spans, coordination members, and surface projection is lower than its frozen v4 baseline.

G3-E3-region-first-connector-role.improvement_definition: A fixture's combined missing+unexpected count across connector labels, coordination members, attachment edges, and both projections is lower than its frozen v4 baseline.

post_development_protocol.on_pass: Freeze v5 source and its development report, then collect and label a fresh corpus-external blind holdout with no job, URL, or source-text overlap with any revealed data.
post_development_protocol.canonicalizer_unlock_condition: Only a one-time pass of every unchanged blind-holdout gate unlocks canonicalizer implementation. A development pass alone never does.
post_development_protocol.on_fail: Do not canonicalize and do not weaken a threshold. Diagnose the frozen failure and preregister a new version before changing v5.
